description:
Implement the coordinate-map abstraction recording, for every derived-code transformation, the explicit mapping between derived and mother-code coordinates, with compact representations for regular patterns.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A coordinate-map type maps derived positions to mother positions and composes across chained transformations, with compact range/permutation representations avoiding full vectors for regular cases.
- [hard] REQ-02: Property tests cover composition associativity and round-trip consistency.
title: Implement the coordinate-map provenance abstraction
